text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you still working?
...It's Christmas today, you know?
choice_data_list: A lot happens at the end of the year, after all.
A lot happens at the end of the year, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Is that something
I can't help you with?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't have any particular plans... and I'm free anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about it, I don't have any other plans for today anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...What's with that look? Just because it's Christmas
doesn't mean everyone has plans, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I already stopped by the Christmas party,
so I figured I'd spend the rest of the time relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean,
at least figure that much out on your own."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So, it's fine.
Come on, let's get this over with quickly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...A Trainer's job entails
way more than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...A Trainer's job entails
way more than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I thought I understood, but...
actually seeing something like this, it's just... how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Must be tough, huh.
choice_data_list: It's even more fun than that, though.
It's even more fun than that, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“...You really haven't changed a bit
since the day we first met.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I knew you'd say that.

Mejiro Dober lets out a small laugh
and briskly gets to work.

Mejiro Dober lets out a small laugh
and briskly gets to work.

"Still, is it really all right to drag him into
my work like this? He's been busy for so long,
the least I could do is let him rest today—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
Next are those documents over—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh!? But there's still some left...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's true, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. All right.
We'll pick this up next time, then.
I promise I'll help you finish the rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
That's true, it is Christmas after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm doing this for you or anything...
Leaving things half-done just bugs me.
choice_data_list: Let me treat you to a meal as thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'll help with the rest, too.
Just let me know when you're ready.
choice_data_list: Let me treat you to a meal as thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Dinner?
...On Christmas, with you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...There's no need for thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
B-But that feels kind of,
you know, like *that*... and I didn't expect it to go that far—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Even until now, this whole time...
I'm the one... who should be saying thank you, though."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... A-A meal, right?
...Understood, I'll go.
It's just a meal. I'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Shall we go?
It might have been a while since we had a leisurely meal together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...*ahem*.
If we're eating out, I'll go change.
Wait just a moment."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, though... Since I'm here, I'll go get changed.
Wait just a moment."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...As expected, everywhere was fully booked."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...As expected, everywhere was fully booked."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No need to apologize.
We managed to get into the family restaurant, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was really surprised when that
family called out to me, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...And the people around us noticed too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Well, a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's different from before.
Because now, I finally understand
what that look in their eyes means.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...So please, don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Going to a family restaurant for the first time in a while was fun too.
I had no idea the menu had so many options."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: More than the place or anything else, who I eat with is what's important to me right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Saying something like this out loud
is actually a little embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"D-Don't stare right at my face!
Isn't it good manners to just let things like this slide!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's how I truly feel.
So I have to say it properly.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. Anyway,
Merry Christmas, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Merry Christmas, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It was calm, had great atmosphere,
and the food was delicious... but.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "It's kind of surprising to learn that you knew a place like that, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...It kind of feels grown-up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...No, I see.
You're an adult after all, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Um, care to chat for a bit?
Somewhere a little quieter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...While helping out earlier, a thought crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There are times when I think it can't be helped, or that you're being silly...
but in the end, you're a proper adult in your own way, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're always giving it your all, to the point where I sometimes worry if you're pushing yourself too hard... But even so, it really shows how much of an adult you are, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You pulled me up when I was moping around,
and made me look straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You pulled me up when I was moping around,
and made me look straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even though I put myself down and called myself weak,
you told me I was 'strong.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...A cool adult
who can guide someone like that."
choice_data_list: Being praised that much is a bit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not complimenting you.
Just stating the truth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You always say all kinds of things to me, but when it's said to you, you get embarrassed? ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I kind of think that's nice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of others, and being able to guide them.
...That's the kind of "adult" I mean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't know what the future holds yet, but... if I become "something," I want to be like you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
To become 'someone' who can guide
those girls who wish to become
what they dream to be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Into that kind of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, what?Why are you trembling... Are you cold?"
choice_data_list: This is the best Christmas present ever...
This is the best Christmas present ever...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...Dummy. As if this would be your Christmas present."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. I told you,
I already have a Christmas present prepared for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Here, take this.
You can open it, but I'm not taking any complaints.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Here, take this.
I hope you like it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I wonder... how it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I wonder... how it is.
Opening the present revealed—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...A brooch. Since it's small,
I don't think it'll get in the way."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There's no real meaning behind it.
It just looked like it was glowing so softly when I found it,
that before I knew it, I had picked it up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"And then, your face just somehow
popped into my head, so..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"So... I just thought
it would really suit you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Please do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Please do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...
Merry Christmas, Trainer.

Gazing at the city lights from the hill with Mejiro Dober,
we enjoyed a quiet Christmas night.
